schemes.name: National Scholarship for Higher Education
schemes.purpose: Financial support for tuition and hostel fees for students from low-income families.
schemes.explanation: This scheme pays part of your college fees directly to your institution if your family's income is below the limit and you are enrolled in a recognised course. You apply once a year and renew each year you stay enrolled.
eligibility: Enrolled in a recognised college or university
Not already receiving another central scholarship for the same course
steps: Create an account on the National Scholarship Portal
Fill in personal and academic details
Upload the required documents
Submit the form before the deadline
Track status on the portal using your application ID

schemes.name: Disability Support Pension
schemes.purpose: Monthly financial assistance for persons with 40% or more certified disability.
schemes.explanation: A fixed monthly amount is paid into your bank account if you hold a valid disability certificate showing 40% or more disability. Payments continue as long as your certificate stays valid.
eligibility: Disability certificate showing 40% or more disability
Family income below the state-specified limit
Resident of the state for at least 3 years
steps: Visit the nearest social welfare office or apply online
Fill in the pension application form
Attach the disability certificate and other documents
Submit for verification
Pension begins after approval, usually within 60 days

schemes.name: Senior Citizen Health Insurance
schemes.purpose: Free or low-cost health coverage for citizens aged 60 and above.
schemes.explanation: This scheme covers hospital treatment costs up to a yearly limit for senior citizens, including pre-existing conditions after a short waiting period. Enrollment is done once and renewed yearly.
eligibility: Not covered under another government health scheme
steps: Visit the nearest empanelled hospital or Common Service Centre
Fill in the enrollment form
Submit identity and age proof
Receive your health card by post or SMS link
Show the card at any empanelled hospital for cashless treatment

schemes.name: Working Women Hostel Assistance
schemes.purpose: Subsidised hostel accommodation for working women and trainees in cities away from home.
schemes.explanation: This scheme provides safe, low-cost hostel accommodation for women working or training away from their hometown, including a daycare facility where available.
eligibility: Working woman or woman under vocational training
Annual income below the state-specified limit
Living away from her home district for work
steps: Locate a scheme-registered hostel in your city
Fill in the hostel admission form
Submit employment and income proof
Pay the subsidised monthly fee after approval
Renew documents annually
